name: Dreamwork
tagline: The job search agent that only applies where you fit
maker_comment_excerpt: Hey Product Hunt - Colin here, one of the makers of Dreamwork. Quick backstory. I originally started building the product when my pregnant wife was laid off from Indeed. I wanted to create a tool for her that looked exactly like the tool I would build for myself if I were looking for another job in tech. I also wanted to spite Indeed by building a better boat than they could. We now have 18,000 users and the spite has only minimally subsided. Why Dreamwork? Applying for a job is broken right now
